queries.lowest_stock: SELECT i.snapshot_date,i.stock_on_hand AS value FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(j.snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory AS j) ORDER BY 2,p.product_name LIMIT 10
queries.category_stock: SELECT i.snapshot_date,p.category,SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS value FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(j.snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory AS j) GROUP BY i.snapshot_date,p.category LIMIT 200
queries.top_category: SELECT i.snapshot_date,p.category,SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS value FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(j.snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory AS j) GROUP BY i.snapshot_date,p.category ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1
queries.lowest_fill: SELECT i.snapshot_date,i.fill_rate FROM commerce.inventory AS i JOIN commerce.products AS p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date=(SELECT MAX(j.snapshot_date) FROM commerce.inventory AS j) ORDER BY 2,p.product_name LIMIT 10
queries.history: SELECT i.snapshot_date,SUM(i.stock_on_hand) AS value FROM commerce.inventory AS i WHERE i.snapshot_date>='2022-01-01' AND i.snapshot_date<'2023-01-01' GROUP BY i.snapshot_date ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200
